Title: Verify that a customer can launch the payment plugin from an integrating app and complete a guest checkout card payment successfully
Tags: GK Pay Biz; Guest Checkout; Payment Plugin; Smoke

Step Action: In the integrating app, initiate payment (e.g. tap "Pay Now" / "Checkout")

Step Expected: The GK Pay Biz payment plugin opens, displaying the merchant's branding and the payment details passed by the merchant

Step Action: Proceed to the Review and Confirm screen
Step Expected: Merchant Name, Product/Service Description, Payment Amount, Fees, Taxes, Total Amount Due, and Currency are all displayed; Total equals Amount + Fees + Tax

Step Action: Select "Manual Card Entry (Guest Checkout)" as the payment method
Enter a valid full name (e.g. "Naomi Silvera"), a valid email address and a valid phone number
Step Expected: Values are accepted

Step Action: Enter valid card details: cardholder name, a valid card number, a valid future expiry date (MM/YYYY), and a valid CVV for the card brand

Step Expected: A loading indicator is shown while the payment is processed
3DS challenge is completed successfully
Payment success confirmation is shown, with the merchant name and amount displayed
